shared: One installation shared across your games.
confirm_remove: Remove the downloaded files for this version? Game settings are preserved.
description: Generates one intermediate frame per real frame (2×) through Vulkan.
install_first: Download the component in Manage to enable it here.
next_launch: Changes are saved automatically and apply the next time you open the game.
running: Close the game before changing its settings.
supported: Requires a 64-bit Vulkan graphics process, natively or through DXVK/VKD3D.
flatpak: AFMF is not available for Flatpak launchers yet.
requires-wow64: This 32-bit Windows game requires a Proton with the new WoW64 mode enabled.
native-32-bit: Native 32-bit Linux games are not supported by this runtime.
unknown: The executable architecture could not be confirmed. A 64-bit Vulkan process is required.
unsupported_entry: Register this installation in the library to configure its launch.
conflict: Disable ML frame generation and the advanced OptiScaler option before enabling AFMF.
exclusive: Enabling AFMF automatically disables the other frame generator for this game.
mode_hint: Quality favors fewer artifacts; performance lowers GPU cost.
search_hint: High search follows wider motion at a higher GPU cost.
fast_hint: Blend smooths fast motion; repeat avoids warping.
minimum_hint: Below this rate no frame is generated. Zero always generates.
pacing_hint: Spaces frames evenly by briefly holding each real frame.
gamescope: Gamescope compatibility is applied automatically on launch.
how_text: Download the runtime, enable AFMF for the game, then launch or relaunch it. For another launcher, configure the PeliRun command once below. Later changes use the same profile.
compatibility: Use one frame generator at a time. In-game frame generation must be disabled. A 2× generator cannot add frames when V-Sync already holds the game at the display refresh rate.
bridge_missing: Game launch settings are unavailable in this host version.
overview_hint: Saved AFMF configuration; runtime activity is confirmed in the game.
